_about: Aircraft type and engine lookup table for Spotter's Companion. 'engineOptions' are the engine options offered for the TYPE. They never say which engine a particular aircraft has.

_verification.verified-secondary: Every engine option was confirmed by a search-result excerpt or summary of the cited source (type certificate data sheet, regulator notice or manufacturer). The PDFs themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so a human check against the current TCDS is still recommended.
_verification.partly-unverified: Some engine options (verified: false) could not be confirmed and are listed for checking.
_verification.unverified: No engine option could be confirmed. Listed for completeness; check before relying on it.
